Yuelan (the "App") is a local, offline-first tool. This policy explains how the App handles your data.

1. Data storage
Your period records, cycle settings and reminder settings are stored only in the local SQLite database and local preferences on your device, and are never uploaded to any server. The App requires no account and does not collect names, phone numbers, ID numbers or contacts.

2. Permissions
- Notifications: used to send period reminders and custom reminders.
- Alarms & reminders (exact alarms): used to fire reminders on time; without it reminders may be delayed.
- Receive boot completed: used only to rebuild reminder alarms after reboot or app update.
- Location (optional): used only to request local weather from Open-Meteo. If denied, a default city coordinate is used and recording still works. Location is not stored by the App.

3. Network access
The App may send approximate coordinates to Open-Meteo (api.open-meteo.com) solely to fetch weather; no period data is included. If an update-check URL is configured, the App requests it only to read version information. The App contains no ads, analytics or social SDKs and does not share your data with third parties.

4. Export and deletion
You can export your data to a local file through the system file picker and delete all data in Settings at any time. Uninstalling the App also removes the local database.

5. Contact
If you have questions about this policy, please contact us through the contact information shown in the App.

Welcome to Yuelan!

1. Service
This App is a local period tracking and prediction tool providing cycle records, four-phase predictions, calendar, statistics, custom reminders and app icon customization.

2. Not medical advice
Predictions are calculated from the data you enter and common cycle patterns. They are for reference only and do not constitute medical diagnosis or treatment advice. Please consult a doctor for health concerns.

3. Data and backup
Your data is stored locally on your device. Please use "Export Data" to keep your own backup. Uninstalling the App, clearing app data or changing devices may cause data loss, and the App is not liable for such loss.

4. Icon customization
If you use the icon customization service, images you provide are used only to generate the corresponding custom installation package and for no other purpose. Please make sure you have the right to use the images you submit.

5. Disclaimer
The App is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, the developer is not liable for any direct or indirect loss arising from the use of, or inability to use, the App.

6. Changes
We may update this agreement with new versions, and the updated content will be shown in the App. Continued use means you accept the updated agreement.
